units.source_text: 那是辆红色车身的公共汽车。

en.t: It was a bus with a red body.

units.source_text: 姐姐把竹笼子抱在膝上，嗅到了新鲜香菇的气味。

en.t: My older sister held the bamboo basket on her lap and caught the scent of fresh shiitake mushrooms.

units.source_text: 她那从脸颊到下巴颏的线条非常柔和。

en.t: The line of her face from her cheek to her chin was very soft.
